title: Wars & Treaties
summary: A curated selection of major wars and the treaties that ended them, with parties and outcomes.
source: Historical facts. A curated selection across world history, not exhaustive; outcomes stated neutrally.

rows.name: Peloponnesian War
rows.outcome: Sparta defeated Athens, ending Athenian dominance in Greece.

rows.name: Punic Wars
rows.outcome: Rome destroyed Carthage and dominated the western Mediterranean.

rows.name: Magna Carta
rows.outcome: Limited royal power; a foundation of constitutional government.

rows.name: The Crusades
rows.outcome: A series of religious wars over the Holy Land; no lasting Crusader hold.

rows.name: Hundred Years' War
rows.outcome: France ultimately prevailed; England lost most of its French lands.

rows.name: Treaty of Tordesillas
rows.outcome: Divided newly explored lands between the two powers along a meridian.

rows.name: Thirty Years' War
rows.parties: Catholic vs. Protestant states of Europe
rows.outcome: Ended by the Peace of Westphalia, which established state sovereignty.

rows.name: Peace of Westphalia
rows.outcome: Ended the Thirty Years' War; basis of the modern nation-state system.

rows.name: American Revolutionary War
rows.outcome: U.S. independence, confirmed by the Treaty of Paris (1783).

rows.name: Treaty of Paris
rows.outcome: Britain recognized U.S. independence.

rows.name: French Revolution
rows.outcome: Ended the monarchy; rise of the republic and eventually Napoleon.

rows.name: Louisiana Purchase
rows.outcome: The U.S. doubled in size, buying the territory from Napoleon.

rows.name: Napoleonic Wars
rows.outcome: Napoleon was defeated at Waterloo (1815); monarchies restored.

rows.name: War of 1812
rows.outcome: Stalemate; confirmed U.S. sovereignty (Treaty of Ghent).

rows.name: Congress of Vienna
rows.outcome: Redrew the map of Europe after Napoleon; aimed at a balance of power.

rows.name: Treaty of Nanking
rows.outcome: Ended the First Opium War; ceded Hong Kong to Britain.

rows.name: Mexican–American War
rows.outcome: Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo; the U.S. gained the modern Southwest.

rows.name: American Civil War
rows.outcome: Union preserved; slavery abolished by the 13th Amendment.

rows.name: World War I
rows.outcome: Allied victory; ended by the Treaty of Versailles (1919).

rows.name: Treaty of Versailles
rows.outcome: Ended WWI; imposed harsh terms on Germany, sowing future conflict.

rows.name: World War II
rows.outcome: Allied victory; led to the United Nations and the Cold War.

rows.name: Korean War
rows.outcome: Armistice; Korea remained divided at the 38th parallel.

rows.name: Vietnam War
rows.outcome: North Vietnamese victory; the country was reunified.

rows.name: Cold War
rows.outcome: Ended with the collapse of the Soviet Union; no direct U.S.–USSR war.

rows.name: Camp David Accords
rows.parties: Egypt and Israel (brokered by the U.S.)
rows.outcome: Framework leading to the 1979 Egypt–Israel peace treaty.

rows.name: Gulf War
rows.outcome: Coalition expelled Iraq from Kuwait.
